output.reason: [ev-25015016b295] says only that Kubernetes 1.32 is now the minimum supported version, and [ev-f88a947c0d4c] lists ">= 1.32.0" as the minimum required. Neither says that installing or upgrading on an older cluster fails, is gated or is refused. So the proposed upgrade-blocked consequence (critical, mandatory work) claims more than the evidence shows. Deciding the consequence needs evidence of what happens on clusters below 1.32: for example, a version check in flux install, bootstrap or check that refuses older clusters, or an API that breaks on them.
